This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the Opposite Party-State.
3.

The present application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the Petitioner seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Nabarangpur PS Case No.176 of 2024 corresponding to G.R Case No. 677 of 2024, pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Nabarangpur, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/294/323/506 of the I.P.C.
4.
It appears that earlier the petitioner had approached this Court by filing ABLAPL No.4512 of 2024, which was disposed of on 26.06.2024 by directing the petitioner to surrender before the Court below.

However, the petitioner instead of surrendering before the learned court below, has again approached this Court by filing the present bail application on 30.09.2024, roughly three months after the earlier order dated 26.06.2024.
This Court, in view of the above facts, is of the observation that since there is no change of circumstances in the present case, this Court is not inclined to entertain this ABLAPL application.

5. Further, considering such submissions by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner is granted four weeks' time to surrender pursuant to order dated 26.06.2024 passed in ABLAPL No.
